blurb: Mongolia's capital, on the steppe of Genghis Khan.

facts.t: About 54 km east of the city, a 40-metre steel statue of Genghis Khan on horseback, finished in 2008, stands where legend says he found a golden whip.

src.n: Wikipedia: Equestrian statue of Genghis Khan

facts.t: The Mongol capital Karakorum, built by Genghis Khan's son Ögedei from 1235, lies about 360 km west, by the monastery of Erdene Zuu.
